text:
alex: Heads up — a Dedicated G5 commit for acct acme-corp isn't showing as 'fulfilled' in the reservation queue. Request alloc-20260912-7721 is stuck in PENDING due to a billing flag. Customer is on a hard deadline tomorrow. :exclamation:

marta: ugh, which region? us-west2 again?

alex: yep us-west2. We have capacity but the commit was mis-tagged as 'spot' on the billing side so the queue rejected it.

raj: pinging @billing-bot to see why the tag mismatch didn't auto-resolve. Also can we do a temporary reroute to eu-west1 G5? Latency might be ok for them.

billing-bot: [automated] Invoice hold: account=acme-corp reason=outstanding_invoice_2026-09-05. Action required by finance to clear. Related allocation: alloc-20260912-7721.

jamie: If finance can't clear in time we can propose a short-term swap: move them to a burst slot on the pooled G4s for 48h and schedule the G5 commit to take effect once billing is cleared. That avoids churn.

alex: can we guarantee runtime for their 99th percentile? They require <=150ms p95 for embeddings pipeline. G4 might push that.

raj: quick mitigation plan: 1) contact sales to prioritize invoice clearance (marta) 2) temporarily route non-latency-critical traffic to eu-west1 G5 (jamie) 3) enable aggressive KV caching + reduce max tokens for embeddings to cut p95 by ~30% (oncall)

marta: calling Sales/Fin now. also leaving a note on the customer SLA ticket.

oncall: I can flip the routing rule and add the cache tweak. Will also add a canary header so we can quickly rollback if latency regresses.

jamie: command to move routing (internal):
```
# switch policy for acme-corp to eu-west1 fallback
redwoodctl route update --account acme-corp --policy fallback_region=eu-west1 --priority=high
```

alex: thanks. after sales updates the billing hold, we should re-tag the commit to 'reserved' and push alloc-20260912-7721 through the queue.

marta: sales replied — finance will release hold within 2 hours if we provide the invoice reference. I've posted it. they said 'if not cleared, we want a documented mitigation to prevent churn'.

raj: logging mitigation and timeline in the ticket. Also filing a follow-up: improve billing-tag validation so commits don't silently land as spot. Filing RFC.

alex: appreciate the quick moves. keep updates in this thread. once allot goes green i'll trigger a permanent handoff. :thumbsup:
